title: Schauberger taken by SS to secret work

tellings.quote: In 1941, an SS officer approached Schauberger in Austria, which prompted a period of complete silence in his life.

plain: In 1941 an officer of the SS, Nazi Germany's elite force, approached the Austrian inventor Viktor Schauberger, and after that his life went completely silent, which is taken to mean he was put to secret work, with Czechoslovakia named as one place. Michels tells it himself in a documentary episode, drawing on a letter Schauberger wrote to his son Walter Schauberger. If true, it would place Schauberger inside secret Nazi research during the war.
